integrity: Finite code checks independently verify representative atomic diagrams and many parameter instances; all-parameter statements are proved by explicit circular-ball intersection identities and sign analysis, not by finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected powers of cycles with integer k>=1 and n>=2k+1, pure adjacency/equality, quantifier rank at most three. Representative sharpness is internal to this graph family. Ordinary cycles k=1 were classified in earlier work; independent scientific verification has not occurred. Complete coverage of unindexed literature cannot be guaranteed.
title: Eleven rank-three theories of finite cycle powers
